notes.title: UPDATE 0.1.1
notes.content:
- Fixed the bug where when the player clicked "resume" in the pause menu the character would jump.
- Some parts of some stages have been modified for better player experience.
- The time between witch shots has been modified, making some stages less punitive.
- The character jumping bug that was occurring with some people has been fixed.
